findings.title: Mirror mypy shows legacy-module errors without MYPYPATH workaround
findings.invariant: The fresh mirror must not masquerade a mirror-only import-resolution artifact as an R10 source defect.

Mirror mypy on a byte-identical src tree reports 3 errors in legacy modules (projections.py:1711, database.py:96/234); setting MYPYPATH to the repo src makes the mirror static gate pass (round-1 documented workaround).
